intent: A compact project explorer with nested folder disclosures, a selected-file inspector and keyboard-accessible file actions, ready for developer workspaces.

layout.direction: Keep the project hierarchy and selected-file reader side by side in wide containers and stack them on phones. Use a compact 14px mono project heading, 13px mono filenames, a 16px selected-file heading and 14px descriptive copy. Preserve neutral hairlines and surfaces. Give the navigation pane a 480px height cap and local scrolling, with 192px minimum node widths so deep folders stay reachable without scrolling the project card sideways.
layout.container: Size to the parent with @container. Keep the root width at 100%, capped to the focused component, with 24px desktop and 16px narrow padding.

typography.heading: 14px compact project heading; 16px mono selected-file heading

motion.entrance: Keep the project navigation stable. Each keyed file reader arrives with opacity and a 4px rise over 240ms.
motion.interaction: Folder chevrons rotate over 150ms; folder disclosure semantics remain immediate. Use the existing hover, press and visible-focus treatments.
motion.reduced: Listen to live preference changes and stop and settle the current reader immediately without replacing the focused file button. Disable chevron transitions under reduced motion.

responsive.rules: Wrap long copy; stack secondary details inside narrow containers; keep any horizontal scrolling local and keyboard accessible.

accessibility: Use native buttons and form controls with visible 2px focus rings.
Provide labels, meaningful states and polite feedback where actions update content.
Keep IDs instance-scoped with useId; support multiple instances and empty custom data.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no automatic action or navigation.

content.defaults: Use the realistic default content from the source; expose content and collection inputs as typed props.

props.name: nodes
props.description: Nested files and folders with globally unique IDs. Sibling reordering retains logical focus; depth remains capped at 24. Deep and large trees scroll inside their keyboard-focusable navigation pane.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: Controlled selected file ID. File actions are read-only without onSelect; folder disclosure remains available.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Synchronous selection notification with an independent deep copy of the chosen file record. The host owns loading and persistence. Folder buttons use native disclosure semantics rather than an ARIA tree.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.

avoid: Remote images, fake network success or hidden external dependencies.
Decorative status badges, gradients as filler, low-contrast text.
Unlabelled controls, hover-only functionality, overflow at 320px.
contract: Keep ExplorerNode and FileExplorerProps. Nodes provide stable globally unique IDs, names, file/folder kinds, optional children and optional detail. Preserve the existing 24-level guard for malformed nesting.

Use native folder buttons with aria-expanded and linked lists. Closed descendants leave keyboard and accessibility navigation immediately. Keep the file visible in the reader when its containing folder closes.
Key siblings by logical IDs so host reordering keeps the focused file. Keep disclosure IDs scoped to each component instance and let long names retain their complete accessible labels.

SelectedId controls the reader; defaultSelectedId initializes local selection. Controlled file actions without onSelect are disabled, while folder disclosure stays available. Host replacement that removes the selected file returns the reader to Select a file.
onSelect receives an independent deep copy synchronously. The host owns asynchronous loading, navigation and persistence. Do not add a fabricated save receipt or retry contract.

Keep the navigation keyboard-focusable and independently scrollable. Deep file focus and long collections must keep the project heading fixed horizontally. Empty projects, empty folders and nesting limits have written states.
Name the selected-file region from its heading. Support long descriptions, opaque IDs and independent project instances with no duplicate DOM IDs.
